request: Build a short link service with durable HTTP(S) links, optional aliases and expiry, redirects, statistics and a health endpoint.
criteria: POST /api/v1/shorten accepts a valid destination and returns 201 with a code and shortUrl. A supplied alias resolves to its stored destination.
GET /{code} redirects a live link (302), rejects an unknown code (404) and rejects an expired link (410). HEAD /{code} does not increment redirect counts.
GET /api/v1/stats/{code} reports the stored destination and redirect count; /health reports UP. Preserve the legacy link, preview and aggregate stats endpoints.
